references.text: Both verses illustrate that deep sorrow and humility are the path to prayer that is heard by God.
Both verses show the pattern where deep sorrow triggers a combination of weeping, fasting, and prayer to God.
Both verses define prayer as an outpouring of deep pain and helplessness directly before God's presence.
Both verses emphasize that prayer in despair is an active, high-reaching expression of the whole person toward God.
